joint_head.face_scope: Native COCO nose/eyes from existing3view RANSAC screen, ears excluded, hand-cache overlap unknown. Optional directional visibility freezes the initial front-camera set during this inner fit, so optimization cannot hide residuals by turning away. Anchor/visibility definitions recorded separately; metrics across different definitions are not comparable quality evidence. Fixed torso/shape/fingers, only worn neck/head change. Existing body depth is held fixed in this inner iteration and must be regenerated for outer visibility update.

joint_motion.scope: All300/8-camera object masks with actual updated-canonical-human depth. Input face error decreases, silhouette slightly declines; not an accepted quality gain.

scene_and_videos.scope: Shared container hash/load and canonical/motion tensor checks plus video decode counts. Explicit head geometry change is intentional; does not assert image improvement, true helmet shape, novel-view accuracy or correct contact.

diagnostics.scope: Each camera contributes at most one best-angle representative to an unweighted median reference, so one high-angle view cannot dominate the consistency vote. Retain samples close to that reference only with enough distinct cameras agreeing; rejected/single-view texels remain unknown and any later fill is inference. No stage restriction, white-shell or dark-lining color gate; common multi-camera registration bias can survive. Fixed lighting/exposure/pose ambiguity remains.

negative_controls.scope: Synthetic failure controls only. Does not establish real-data correspondence, appearance quality or recovered albedo.

texel_consensus.scope: Same geometry/motion/camera correction/frame-selection as previous texture, only per-texel independent-camera consensus changed. Coverage decreases and dark patches remain in reviewed closeups. Unadopted; filled/median colors remain inferred, not recovered observation.

baseline_contact.scope: Weak at-least-one palm/fingertip contact prior for held30..135, only points corroborated in>=3 cameras and fitted reprojection mean<30native px. Fixed initial frame set further requires some hand point within.08 human-model units. Distance to8192 deterministic area samples of the full shell, tolerance.01 model units, normalized by actual avatar scale. Coarse correspondence, finite surface sampling and hand fitting errors remain; this is not measured physical contact, a metric-unit statement or a nonpenetration/collision constraint. Frames without corroborated nearby hands remain unknown.

weak_hand_contact.scope: Actual106 held-frame diagnostic plus deliberate object displacement. Baseline already satisfies the at-least-one-point proximity threshold in all106 screened frames, so adding this weak prior alone is not evidence of a useful contact improvement. Signed shell collision and extended-hand/Gaussian nonpenetration remain unimplemented.

camera_assignment_audit.scope: Exhaustive8! assignment search using same-frame12 torso/limb detector correspondences, rawscore>2 and in_image. Even frames rank assignments, odd frames evaluate the same fixed ranking; temporal correlation remains. Pairwise symmetric epipolar medians then trimmed23-of28 mean, thresholds fixed before search. Tests extrinsics-only and whole K/W serial misassignment hypotheses. Detector semantics, synchronization, original calibration quality and degenerate camera geometry remain possible confounds. No calibration/serial mapping file changed, no candidate accepted automatically; requires multiview3D and static-background confirmation.
camera_assignment_audit.conclusion: Best assignment remains around57-58native pixels; no usable mapping accepted or calibration changed.

helmet_feature_observability.scope: Cached ALIKED/LightGlue helmet-interior crop features; actual positive candidate mask eroded4native pixels and fitted-hand uncertainty excluded.512-square crops rescale native pixels explicitly; no shape/model agreement gate. Matchscore>.2, supplied-camera symmetric epipolar<3native px, unique-camera tracks>=3, DLT maximum reprojection3px, positive depth and ray span>=3deg. Tests whether real image detail can constrain shared helmet geometry/pose rather than recycling biased baked colors. Segmentation/detector/feature/calibration errors and white-shell sparsity remain; no replacement pose/geometry adopted, only2times tested. Private point/track arrays and original images excluded from public release.

scope: Updated full300 candidate and explicit failed/weak hypotheses. Body shape remains beta0 in this scene, nonzero-beta accepted-appearance trial is separate work in progress. Full goal, nonpenetration, helmet recovery, nonrigid backpack and conventional assets remain incomplete.
